name: plugin.omarchy_theming_engine
description: Omarchy Quattro theming engine, palette resolution, sed-compatible template renderer, and WCAG contrast analyzer.

entrypoints.name: omarchy_list_themes
entrypoints.description: List all bundled Omarchy desktop themes with metadata and color palette preview

entrypoints.name: omarchy_get_theme_palette
entrypoints.description: Retrieve fully resolved color palette for a theme, including ANSI and semantic aliases

entrypoints.name: omarchy_render_theme_template
entrypoints.description: Render a configuration template string using Omarchy theme tokens, mix functions, and gradient syntax

parameters.name: template_content
parameters.description: Template text containing {{ key }}, {{ key_strip }}, {{ key_rgb }}, or {{ mix ... }} placeholders

parameters.name: theme_name
parameters.description: Name of the theme to render the template with

entrypoints.name: omarchy_validate_theme_contrast
entrypoints.description: Calculate WCAG 2.1 relative luminance and contrast ratios between text and background colors

parameters.name: theme_name
parameters.description: Name of the theme to evaluate for accessibility and readability
